modmenu.summaryTranslation.leaflod: Bushy leaves only near you, plain cubes farther away: more FPS in dense forests, the resource pack stays untouched.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.leaflod: Keeps the full model of bushy-leaves resource packs (e.g. Vervada's enhanced plants) only near you: farther away, leaves are drawn as plain cubes and grass and ferns as a simple cross. Saves a lot of GPU work in dense forests without changing the look around you. The resource pack itself stays untouched.
leaflod.config.title: Leaf LOD
leaflod.config.enabled.tooltip: When off, all leaves use the full model of the resource pack.
leaflod.config.mode.tooltip: Leaf budget: the nearest N leaf blocks keep the full (bushy) model, so the distance adapts to how dense the trees are. Fixed distance: full model within a fixed distance.
leaflod.config.budget.tooltip: Leaf-budget mode: how many of the nearest leaf blocks keep the full model (a small oak has about 60 leaf blocks, a giant jungle tree several hundred). GPU cost grows with this number.
leaflod.config.min_radius.tooltip: Leaf-budget mode: leaves at least this close always keep the full model, even in very dense forests.
leaflod.config.distance.tooltip: Fixed-distance mode: leaves closer to the camera than this keep the full (bushy) model; farther leaves are rendered as plain cubes.
leaflod.config.outer_leaves_only: Only outer leaves get bush planes
leaflod.config.outer_leaves_only.tooltip: Within the full-model distance, leaves completely surrounded by other leaves or solid blocks get only the plain cube (their bush planes would be hidden inside the canopy anyway). Saves GPU work in dense trees.
leaflod.config.clip_under_snow.tooltip: Leaves with snow (or a carpet, leaf litter, petals, powder snow) on top keep their bush planes on the sides, but nothing sticks out above the leaf block, so the bush no longer shines through the snow.
leaflod.config.grass_enabled.tooltip: Also limit the heavy grass, fern and bush models of the resource pack: near the camera the full model, farther away a simple X-cross with the same texture.
leaflod.config.grass_distance.tooltip: Grass, ferns and bushes closer than this keep the full resource pack model.
leaflod.config.zoom_enabled: Zoom: extend bushy range in view
leaflod.config.zoom_enabled.tooltip: While zooming (Zoomify, spyglass or any other zoom that narrows the field of view), leaves and grass inside the visible area keep the full model up to the normal distance times the zoom factor. Everything outside the view is unchanged.
leaflod.config.zoom_max_distance.tooltip: Upper limit for the zoom-extended leaf distance (never more than the render distance; grass at most 96 blocks). Larger values show more bushy trees through the zoom but cost more GPU time and chunk rebuilds while zoomed.
leaflod.config.zoom_grace.tooltip: How long the extended range stays after you stop zooming, so quickly zooming in again does not rebuild chunks twice.
leaflod.config.current_radius.none: Current full-model distance: - (not in a world)
